annotations.title: Request (or check) deletion of a person’s Reddit ads data

description: Honour a person’s data-deletion request on Reddit Ads: asks Reddit to PERMANENTLY delete the ads data it holds for their identifiers — EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, IDFA, AAID or EXTERNAL_ID, 1–200 per job — across the shared ad account, or only under one pixel (pixelId; Reddit requires business-admin access for that). Emails and phone numbers are canonicalised and SHA-256 hashed here exactly as the audience upload and Conversions API hash them, so the deletion matches what was sent; a 64-hex hash you made yourself passes through. It removes ads data (custom-audience matches, conversion records) and never anyone’s Reddit account. Call WITHOUT confirm first — nothing is sent and the answer states the scope — then again with confirm:true. Reddit processes jobs DAILY and finishes within 30 days: pass jobId alone to check one (QUEUED, COMPLETED or FAILED), at most once a day.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

confirm.description: true only after the user approved — deletion is irreversible

identifiers.description: who to delete; omit when checking a jobId

type.description: EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, IDFA, AAID or EXTERNAL_ID

value.description: the identifier in plain form, or a 64-char SHA-256 hash

jobId.description: check an existing job instead of creating one

pixelId.description: limit the deletion to one pixel’s data (from list_reddit_ads_pixels)

name: reddit_ads_data_deletion
